device.description: 12-bit 3.3 kSPS delta-sigma ADC with internal reference and I2C interface (single differential input)
device.note: ads1013.pdf (SBAS473F) p.3 pin functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 I2C timing, p.11 data rate, p.12-13 comparator and conversion-ready pin, p.14 reset and operating modes, p.16 address table and general call, p.16-17 register access, p.19 data format, p.20-23 register map; ads1013-q1.pdf (SBAS511E) p.3 for the -Q1 parts and the NKS package

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.note: reset 8583h; OS write 1 starts a single conversion, reads 0 while converting, 1 when idle

pages: p.3 (pins, RUG/DGS same numbering), p.4 (ROC: VDD 2-5.5 V, digital inputs GND-5.5 V), p.11 (data rates 128-3300 SPS, conversion time 1/DR), p.13 (conversion-ready: Hi_thresh MSB 1, Lo_thresh MSB 0, COMP_QUE != 11b, 8 us pulse in continuous mode), p.14 (power-up in power-down/single-shot, general call reset 06h), p.16 (ADDR GND/VDD/SDA/SCL -> 48h/49h/4Ah/4Bh), p.16-17 (pointer write then read), p.19 (two's complement, left-justified), p.20-23 (registers); ads1013-q1.pdf p.3 (NKS pinout = DGS numbering)
notModeled: analog inputs, PGA and internal reference (PGA is stored only); the result is the 0 V code
OS=1 writes during a running conversion or in continuous mode: the datasheet says no effect (the engine may restart)
continuous mode: a configuration write lets the running conversion finish with the old settings
~25 us power-up before a single-shot conversion (folded into the conversion time: not added)
conversion time 1 / nominal data rate; the internal oscillator drift is not modeled
a floating ADDR pin (not specified); the SDA strap needs SDA held low 100 ns after SCL falls
HS-mode master code and I2C timing limits
Config bits 14:9 and 4:0 are reserved R/W (stored, reset 000010b / 00011b); Lo_thresh / Hi_thresh are not available on the ADS1013 (p.20): pointer values 10b/11b select no register in the model
the ADS1013 always uses AINP = AIN0, AINN = AIN1 and FSR +-2.048 V
variants: ADS1013 / ADS1014 / ADS1015 share ads1013.pdf (ADS1014: PGA + comparator + ALERT/RDY; ADS1015: also MUX and AIN2/AIN3); own spec files. ADS1014QNKSRQ1 and ADS1015QNKSRQ1 in this skeleton belong to ADS1014 / ADS1015 (ads1013-q1.pdf p.3: pins 2, 6, 7 differ)
